content: {"phoneNote":"Phone first screen reads well, but the hero photos only start at the very bottom and the arched crop of a street scene says little about a barbershop; the whole-page capture also shows the sticky header overlapping the hero text.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero is strong with arched photos and a watermark 'Kos', but the headline is set so large it stacks into four lines and the opening-hours timeline leaves a wide empty right half on Saturday plus a dead right column in 'Kdo vas postriže'.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Reduce the desktop headline size so it sits in two or three lines and the photos align with it; on phone pull the photos up by tightening hero text spacing.","Fill the empty right half of 'Kdo vas postriže' with the barber's portrait or a shop photo; both viewports show a large dead band there.","Replace the generic street photo with a second barbershop image (chair, tools, interior) so both hero pictures speak to the trade."],"blockers":["Phone, whole page: the sticky header overlaps and hides the hero paragraph in the capture, cutting the text 'Strižemo s škarjami ali strojčkom, de-'.","Desktop, whole page: the sticky header overlaps the hero headline, cutting the word 'britev'."]}
